correctness.rationale: The standard Steinberg character-value theorem converts the sharp central projection norm to semisimple centralizer p-parts. Twisted-Frobenius orbit counts and standard unitary/linear centralizer orders yield the exact Euler-product coefficients. After dividing out a rational zeta factor, uniformly convergent corrected factors on disks |z|<sqrt(q) give a positive finite limit and exponential coefficient error. Exact rational coefficients and a conjugacy-agnostic enumeration of all 648 elements of U_3(2) agree on 112/27. Dependencies and range are explicit.
